fix(session): clear mission sidecars on Purge/PurgeTombstoned, not only clean Delete (K3)

Review finding K3 (full-branch review, m-2026-09-08-004 round 3), HIGH:
only the clean HandleSessionEnd path (internal/hook's
clearSessionMissionBindings) cleared a session's mission sidecars
(active-mission claim, delegation-binding sidecar, pending-dispatch
store). Store.Delete itself did not, and neither did Purge or
PurgeTombstoned -- the crash-recovery paths for a session that ended
abnormally (SIGKILL, a closed terminal, a crash). A `claude --resume`
reusing that session ID could have its first matching spawn silently
captured by a stale claim or pending dispatch from before the death.

deleteFiles is the ONE low-level primitive Delete, Purge, and
PurgeTombstoned all funnel through, so the sidecar clear now lives
there -- closing the gap for every deletion path at once rather than
duplicating the three Clear* calls across each caller.
internal/session already imports internal/mission for
SessionBoundMissions, so this introduces no new layering dependency.
clearSessionMissionBindings in the hook package is now a harmless
no-op double-clear on the clean path; left in place rather than
refactored, to keep this fix scoped to the crash-recovery gap it closes.

Two regression tests (Delete, Purge) confirmed failing against pre-fix
code via git-stash falsification.
EOF
)"
